args.query: type-safe Kysely queries with node-postgres including a transaction

results.title: pg-mem in-memory Postgres with Kysely for fast DB tests
results.summary: Run Kysely queries against pg-mem through its node-postgres adapter: serial ids, RETURNING, a frozen now(), unique/check/foreign-key constraints, atomic multi-row inserts, joins with aggregates, and snapshot restore (pg-mem does not roll back multi-query transactions).

results.title: Kysely + better-sqlite3 typed queries
results.summary: Type-safe SQL with Kysely on SQLite, including a schema migration, joins and a transaction.

results.title: Drizzle ORM migrations on PGlite (in-memory Postgres)
results.summary: Apply versioned SQL migrations with Drizzle's PGlite migrator, use Postgres features (jsonb, enums, arrays, onConflictDoUpdate) and test against a fresh in-memory database.

results.title: Drizzle ORM + PGlite in-memory Postgres
results.summary: Real Postgres semantics in tests with no server: Drizzle ORM on PGlite (WASM Postgres) with relations, returning() and transactions.

results.title: Auth.js Drizzle adapter on PGlite Postgres (database sessions)
results.summary: Set up @auth/drizzle-adapter with the standard Postgres tables on Drizzle, and test user, account linking and database session lifecycle against in-memory PGlite.

results.title: file-type buffer detection
results.summary: Detect PNG, PDF, ZIP and GIF from small in-memory magic byte buffers with file-type, asserting ext and mime, and undefined for plain text.

results.title: Runtime type checking with typeguard: @typechecked, check_type and generics
results.summary: Enforce annotations at runtime with typeguard: @typechecked functions, standalone check_type, TypeCheckError messages and bounded TypeVars, plus the FIRST_ITEM container gotcha.

results.title: chrono-node natural language dates with a fixed reference and timezone
results.summary: Parse phrases like "tomorrow at 9am", weekday names, ranges and dates inside sentences with chrono-node against a fixed reference instant and UTC offset, plus en.GB day-first parsing.

results.title: Fastify 5 + Zod 4 type provider for typed routes
results.summary: Use fastify-type-provider-zod so Zod 4 schemas validate requests, serialize responses and type handlers in Fastify 5.

results.title: ical-generator .ics feed round-tripped through node-ical
results.summary: Generate an iCalendar feed with ical-generator (escaped text, attendees, a weekly RRULE with an EXDATE) and parse it back with node-ical, expanding the recurrence offline.
